Original examples use author's staged val/test files. Their example gen_results.py averages probabilities across eight random rotation/flip views on test. Tyom SWSL ResNet18.preprocessing: 48x48 grayscale float mapped via bilinear reflection grid to 112x112 RGB standardized by ImageNet mean/std
Tyom SWSL ResNet18.split_evidence: The upstream training notebook loads msambare Kaggle train/ and test/ separately. Training array stays within train/, VAL_FRAC=0.0, preallocated time budget. Released weights contain metadata but no per-example training hash manifest. Publisher reported 72.36% on the combined 7178-image Kaggle test folder with 12 views. This experiment uses at most four.
